result:
I’d make it harder for people to treat each other as disposable.

Not by removing choice. Not by forcing kindness.

Just by taking away the numbness. The part of the mind that makes it easy to say “they’re not like us,” “it’s not my responsibility,” “it won’t really matter.”

If people couldn’t look at another human being and turn them into an abstraction when it suited them, a lot of violence, cruelty, and cruelty-by-indifference would never start.
